title: Wood and Glass
text:
Wood is a common material. It is brown and warm to touch. Many tables and chairs are made of wood.

Glass is different. It is smooth and cold, and you can see through it. We use glass for windows and cups.

questions.text: What do we use glass for?
What can you infer about a glass window?
options: Light can come into a room through it.
It keeps the room completely dark.
It can be eaten like bread.
It is warm to touch like wood.

questions.text: How is wood different from glass?
options: Wood is not see-through, but glass is.
Wood is smooth, but glass is rough.
Wood is cold, but glass is warm.
Wood is used only for cups.

vocabulary.definition: a hard material that comes from trees
a hard, clear material used for windows
having an even surface with no rough parts
